Sometime during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Empire '''invaded''' the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lan Barell/Legends|Lan Barell]]. Among the relief workers trapped on the world was [[Thelonia Redrish]], a [[Kuati/Legends|Kuati]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] who had been participating in relief missions to the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Upon witnessing [[Blood/Legends|bloodshed]] for the first [[Time/Legends|time]], she decided to pick up a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]], and she quickly became a leader among the civilian resistance to the Empire thanks to her natural charm and selflessness. Under her leadership, the planet's inhabitants drove the Empire off their world, and Redrish went on to do the same on many worlds throughout the remainder of the war, eventually becoming a [[General/Legends|general]] in the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The invasion of Lan Barell was first mentioned in the Codex entry for Thelonia Redrish in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
